research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register text of Executive Order 13015 (61 FR 43937, PDF page 1 of the 1996-08-27 issue; sha256 97a82500...), headed Executive Order 13015 of August 22, 1996, White House Commission on Aviation Safety and Security, matching the census register row (1996-08-22). Text and inventory: eight scopes cover sections 1 through 4(b) to the signature; I confirm the inventory. All clauses belong to one advisory commission. Ending: its own term; section 4(b) fixes six months from August 22, 1996, ending February 22, 1997 unless extended by the President, and no extension is held. Executive Order 13062 section 3(e), effective September 30, 1997, later revokes the order. Original grade: Federal Register machine text.
